_help: The project's own facts for the CAD viewer. Keys that start with an underscore are comments. Every key below is optional; leave a key out and the generic default applies. Check the file with: python tools/cad_viewer/viewer_config.py
title: CAD viewer
_skip_parts: Regexes (case-insensitive). A part whose name matches is left out of the pack, so it is also left out of the viewer's mass and CG. Use it for scratch bodies and construction geometry.
_look: Project rules for how a part looks, tried in order BEFORE the built-in material rules. A rule matches when every regex it names matches. 'text' is searched in '<name> <material>'. Classes: coat, fr4, copper, alu, ti, steel, print, cf, soft, film, glass, wire, plain.
_coat_prefix: A conformal-coat shell is a part named <prefix><board part>. The shell renders clear so the board picture shows through it. Empty string = no coat parts.
_board_name_regex: Parts whose name matches count as boards for PCB X-ray (solid while everything else turns to glass), with or without a KiCad file.
_wire_name_regex: Parts whose name matches count as wires for Wire X-ray (wires, cables, flex tails and harness ties solid, everything else glass). Part names are project-specific, so tune this to yours. wire_not_regex removes false hits such as screws and clamps whose names contain a wire word.
_boards: CAD part name -> the repo-relative .kicad_pcb it was built from. render_boards.py renders each file once (top and bottom); pack_mesh.py lays the picture on the part only if the outline size and the silhouette match. Parts of the same file share one render.
_board_no_file: Board-like parts that have no KiCad file. They are listed in the pack as untextured, with the reason, so nobody wonders why a board is plain.

_board_no_file_example.name: ^spacer_board$
_board_no_file_example.reason: mechanical spacer card, builder box only

_board_frames: Optional. The CAD builder's own rule for how a board picture sits on its part: 'u' is the image-right axis, 'n' the normal of the KiCad top face, both in the model frame. It wins when it is as good a silhouette fit as the best one; a frame the STL contradicts is reported and the silhouette pick stays.
_board_gate: Gates a render must pass before it is laid on a part: outline size error per side (absolute mm and fraction, the larger counts), silhouette IoU, and the score distance under which two placements count as a tie (a symmetric board).
